messages:
Maya (Support): Hey team, incoming escalation from Jamal at Acme: per-model throughput panels in Console are showing 0 QPS for all models since ~2026-03-15 03:00 UTC. Customer says API still serving fine. Can someone triage?
customer-jamal: Confirming — API responses normal, latency OK, but the per-model throughput graphs on our org dashboard dropped to flat zero at 03:05 UTC. Overall traffic numbers still show up.
Maya (Support): Thanks. I gathered screenshots and the dashboard timeseries. No alert fired from our SLOs. Attaching our quick checklist: check exporter, prometheus scrape, relabeling, grafana queries.
Alex (eng-platform): I saw a deploy to metrics-exporter around 02:55 UTC for label-sanitization. Could be related. Which metric do the panels use?
Maya (Support): Panels query: sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[5m])) by (model). The exporter used to expose 'model' label; the new release changes it to 'model_id'.
Priya (SRE): That would explain zeroing. If Grafana dashboard still groups by 'model' but metric now has 'model_id', the by(model) returns empty. Quick check: run this in Prometheus console: sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[5m])) by (model) and then by (model_id).
Priya (SRE): Ran the checks — by(model) => 0 series, by(model_id) => non-zero with expected values. Exporter relabel map shows: labels:{"model"->"${id}"} removed in v3.4.2.
Lina (eng-runtime): Confirming change. The sanitize patch swapped the label name to avoid clashes with reserved keys. Oversight: dashboard and alert rules still expect old label.
Maya (Support): Customer-facing impact: visuals broken but functional API. Proposed immediate fix: add a compatibility relabel rule in exporter or in Prometheus scrape config to copy model_id->model, or update Grafana queries to use model_id. Which is faster?
Alex (eng-platform): Fastest is to add a relabel_configs entry in Prometheus scrape to copy label. Example: 
```
- source_labels: [model_id]
  target_label: model
  action: replace
```
That avoids touching dashboards. We can roll a fix to metrics-exporter next week to keep both labels for a transition window.
Priya (SRE): I'll push a hotfix to scraper in staging then prod. Routing: small risk — make sure no collisions. I'll test with query before/after.
Maya (Support): Great. Can you also add a temporary note in the console status banner so customers see we have a degraded dashboard view but API unaffected? Jamal is asking for ETA.
Priya (SRE): ETA: testing now, prod change in ~20m if no issues. I'll post status once live.
obs-bot: Alert suppressed: grafana_missing_series (per-model QPS) — suppressed due to active mitigation.
Maya (Support): Jamal: we will restore per-model graphs within ~30 minutes by adding a compatibility mapping; no API or billing impact. I'll follow up when done. :thumbsup:
customer-jamal: Thanks — appreciated. Please CC our account rep.
Priya (SRE): Prod change applied at 1893461200 UTC. Prometheus scrape updated with relabel copy. Quick verification:
- `sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)` now returns series with expected values.
Lina (eng-runtime): Logging an internal ticket to revert exporter to emit both labels for two weeks then deprecate 'model' in dashboards. Ticket: RINF-7423.
Maya (Support): Closing loop with customer and noting postmortem items: improve deploy checklist for label changes, add dashboard var fallbacks, run integration test that verifies dashboard queries post-metric-change.
Maya (Support): Thanks everyone, marking resolved for now.
